content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the entire over-one-hour video, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the event highlights below right now.

Apple releases short event highlights

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple yesterday also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, along with the Apple Watch Series 12, Ultra 4, and the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation support.

The event lasted just a few minutes shy of 1 hour and 20 minutes, during which Apple stuck to its usual style, with executives taking turns speaking to the camera, interspersed with marketing demonstrations and product advertisements.

If you don't have time to watch it slowly, Apple has also released a rather interesting event highlight reel, where a narrator summarizes the key points of each announcement in fast-forward and rewind style.

Apple has also shared multiple standalone videos, which are essentially the complete announcement segments for each product, all of which you can watch below.
